tools.name: list_photo_presets
tools.description: List the supported ID-photo document presets (France and Canada, with exact millimetre sizes, head-height bands, background rules and official sources), the printable paper formats, the standard grid layouts and usage notes. Takes no parameters.

tools.name: plan_photo_sheet
tools.description: Compute the layout of an ID-photo print sheet without rendering it: resolves the photo size from the preset (or custom millimetres), counts the photos, and checks whether the grid fits the printable area of the chosen paper. Returns a JSON plan with ok, photo/needed/usable dimensions and a message;

tools.name: render_photo_sheet_html
tools.description: Render a self-contained, printable HTML sheet tiling one ID photo at real physical size across a cols x rows grid on the chosen paper, with optional cut guides and image framing (zoom/offset). Pass the photo as an inline base64 data URL (image/jpeg or image/png); without one, the sheet prints sized

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "render_photo_sheet_html" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Render a self-contained, printable HTML sheet tiling one ID photo at real physical size across a cols x rows grid on the chosen paper, with optional cut guides …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
